Six unique tight crops were generated and each emitted/viewed once; the diagonal crop was rotated upright. No source region remains unviewed; the five listed textual loci remain uncertain. No other reader/page was consulted, no OCR/research was used, and no compilation was attempted.

notes.text: The sheet has typed pagination VII 2, an upper-left handwritten SGA 4 XVI reference, and archive number 29. No date, salutation or signature is visible on this sheet.
notes.basis: Observation: full layout, both halves and all margins.

notes.text: The opening paragraph says that 2.1.1 reduces to affine X, calls quasi-compact quasi-separated spaces “cohérent”, invokes base change by f, criticizes use of the full proper-base-change theorem, and then proposes the reduction through 2.1.5 and transcendence degree 1 to the prime-to-p H^1 statement for a proper smooth curve. The words corps de are called into the later change-of-base phrase.
notes.basis: Observation of P1 wording and its insertion call; no proof check or outside theorem consultation.

notes.text: “Je pense présenter les choses ainsi en réédition de SGA 4” is a proposal. “s’il ne l’est déjà (je n’ai pas les textes en main)” explicitly qualifies whether 2.1.1 already appears in full. The proposed task for the recipient is an interpretation in terms of champs.
notes.basis: Observation: P1 final live lines; the removed rappel parenthesis remains transcribed as cancelled.

notes.text: The second paragraph asks to group 2.1.1, 2.1.7 and 2.1.5. The proposed pro-lisse/lisse replacement is enclosed and crossed out, including the interlinear tH. and 1-/l- material. The later list is literally 2.12, 2.1.3, 2.1.4, 2.1.7.1 and literally il sont; these are not normalized.

notes.basis: Observation: crop 05, rotated clockwise 40 degrees from the source. Reading doubt is distinguished from mathematical interpretation.

Every S/G/A/X/V/I and the page-label V/I/I were separately read; no mathematical double-struck alphabet is assigned.

That oblique does not supply a uniquely recoverable linear insertion order. The graphic avoids silently choosing H’s placement after the full condition.
notes.basis: Observation and narrowly stated placement limitation: crop 03. No intended edit chronology is inferred.
